subject: Nordic pilot: dedicated GPU pool request & SOW timeline
messages:
From: Maja Olsen <maja.olsen@norfjord.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-28T09:12:00+02:00
Subject: Pilot request — Nordic dedicated GPU pool

Hi Alex / Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the internal follow-up with engineering and procurement — Norfjord Labs is interested in a 3-month pilot to evaluate dedicated GPU capacity in the Nordics (preferably Frankfurt or Oslo edge), with eventual expansion to a longer-term commitment if latency and cost metrics meet our targets.

Quick high-level numbers from our side: peak concurrent model inferences ~70 qps, average request length ~600 tokens, expectation of burst windows (6–8 hrs/day) around 11:00–19:00 CET. We also have strict data residency and audit requirements for EU customers — I attached a short compliance checklist.

Two asks to start:
- Can you propose a tentative pool size & node type recommendation for a pilot that targets <120 ms 95th percentile latency?
- What's the earliest you could provision a pilot if we agree commercial terms (we're aiming for a July start)?

Attaching: norfjord_workload_profile.csv, norfjord_compliance_requirements.docx

Best,
Maja Olsen
Head of Platform
Norfjord Labs

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maja Olsen <maja.olsen@norfjord.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-28T12:05:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — Nordic dedicated GPU pool

Hi Maja — thanks for the details and the attachments. This is very helpful.

Short answers up front:
- We can provision a pilot sized to your burst + base fairly quickly; my initial sizing suggestion below is conservative and meant to hit your <120 ms p95 target with headroom.
- Earliest provisioning: we can reserve nodes for a July 14th start, subject to final SOW and PO.

Initial proposed pilot configuration (ballpark):
- Node type: A100-80GB (quant-friendly runtime) x 6 nodes (sustained baseline)
- Burst buffer / autoscale: additional 2 nodes in a burst lane for the first 2 weeks, and then configurable autoscale to +4 nodes if telemetry shows sustained higher load
- Estimated token throughput: 10M tokens/day baseline, 18–22M tokens/day during burst windows

I'll loop in our capacity planner (Laura) and deal lead (Rishi) to confirm procurement lead times and finalize the SLA draft. Can you confirm whether Frankfurt residency is acceptable (we can also discuss an Oslo edge pilot, but options and costs differ)?

Thanks — I put a quick action list below.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Maja Olsen <maja.olsen@norfjord.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@norfjord.ai
Date: 2025-06-29T08:47:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — Nordic dedicated GPU pool

Hi Alex — Frankfurt is fine as a starting point; preference for EU-hosted only.

We validated the token estimates with infra — the workload_profile has a 90th percentile that aligns with your numbers. One additional constraint: we need SOC2-aligned audit logs and a 30-day raw KV cache retention for analysis. I'll send a short procurement timeline by EOD.

Also, how do you handle fallbacks if the dedicated pool temporarily under-provisions during our peak windows? Do you have a compatible hosted fallback model?

Cheers,
Maja

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Maja Olsen <maja.olsen@norfjord.ai>
Date: 2025-06-30T10:22:00+02:00
Subject: Action: Norfjord pilot sizing + procurement timeline (please review)

Team — looping you both in to validate the pilot sizing and confirm provisioning timelines. Maja has confirmed Frankfurt residency and provided workload_profile.csv. Key asks:

1) Capacity/ops: Laura — can you confirm whether 6x A100-80GB + initial burst lanes (+2 nodes) is realistic for a July 14th soft start? Please include procurement and provisioning SLAs (image build, runtime config, KV cache policies for 30d).

2) Sales/legal: Rishi — can you confirm deal-side parameters (short pilot SOW, PO cadence, any required credits) and whether we should offer a hosted fallback lane (metered) that would automatically route excess traffic to hosted API when dedicated capacity is saturated? If so, we should add fallbacks to the SOW.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- Jun 30: Confirm sizing & procurement lead times (Redwood) — ACTION: Laura
- Jul 2: Norfjord to send PO draft & procurement calendar — ACTION: Maja
- Jul 3: Redwood to provide draft Pilot SOW + small SLA addendum (SOC2 logs + KV retention) — ACTION: Rishi
- Jul 14: Target pilot start (provisioned) — contingent on signed SOW & PO

Attachments referenced: norfjord_workload_profile.csv (from Maja).

Alex

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maja Olsen <maja.olsen@norfjord.ai>
Date: 2025-07-02T16:04:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Action: Norfjord pilot sizing + procurement timeline (please review)

Alex / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround. Laura, if we can lock the 6x A100-80GB baseline with a +2 burst lane reserved and the option to auto-scale up to +4 within 24 hours of sustained load, I’m comfortable taking this forward as a pilot. Please note procurement will want a clear cancellation window and a trial-rate line item — I suggest a 90-day pilot rate that rolls into either a committed monthly baseline or a short extension.

On fallbacks: yes, offer a metered hosted fallback lane in the SOW (route excess to compatible quantized variant) — specify the cost delta and a soft-threshold trigger at 80% pool utilization. Also include an SLA addendum for SOC2-aligned audit logs and 30-day KV retention; specify export format and access frequency. I attached a short SLA sketch (Norfjord_MAL_POC_SLA.pdf) and will prepare the SOW draft tomorrow.

Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
